description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of SearchImageByText, which is used to search for image information in an Image Search instance based on text
description_zh: 本文为您介绍SearchImageByText的语法及示例，用于根据文字查询图像搜索实例中的图片信息
kebab_example: aliyun imagesearch search-image-by-text --instance-name demoinstance1 --num 10 --start 0 --filter int_attr=1000_AND_str_attr=_value1 --distinct-product-id false --text xxxx --score-threshold 0.50 --api-version 2020-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchImageByText

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Image Search instance. The name can be up to 20 characters in length.
If you have purchased an Image Search instance, log on to the Image Search console (https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com/) to view the instance name.
If you have not purchased an Image Search instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179178.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66569.html.
The instance name is not the instance ID. Make sure you distinguish between them
parameters.help_zh:
图搜实例名称。最多支持20个字符。
如果已经购买图搜实例可登录图像搜索管控台 (https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com/)查看。
如果没有购买图搜实例可参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179178.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66569.html。
这里的实例名称并非实例ID，使用时请区分
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: The number of results to return. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果的数目。取值范围：1~100。默认值为10
parameters.name: num

parameters.help_en: The start position of the results to return. Valid values: 0 to 499. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果的起始位置。取值范围：0~499。默认值为0
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition. The int_attr field supports the following operators: in, not in, greater than (>), greater than or equal to (>=), less than (<), less than or equal to (<=), and equal to (=). The str_attr field supports the following operators: in, not in, equal to (=), and not equal to (!=). You can use AND and OR to connect multiple conditions.
Examples:
int_attr >= 100.
str_attr != "value1".
int_attr = 1000 AND str_attr = "value1".

The filter condition can be up to 4,096 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
过滤条件。int_attr支持的操作符有in、not in、大于号(>)、大于等于号(>=)、小于号(<)、小于等于号(<=)、等于号(=)。str_attr支持的操作符有in、not in、等于号(=)和不等号(!=)，多个条件之间支持AND和OR进行连接。
例如：
int_attr >= 100。
str_attr != "value1"。
int_attr = 1000 AND str_attr = "value1"。

最多支持4096个字符
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: If this parameter is set to true, duplicate data is removed based on the ProductId field during the search
parameters.help_zh: 如果为true则检索时根据ProductId字段进行去重复数据
parameters.name: distinct_product_id

parameters.help_en:
The description text for searching images. Chinese and English are supported.

The text can be up to 512 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
搜索图片的描述文本，支持中英文。

最多支持512个字符
parameters.name: text

parameters.help_en: The similarity score threshold. After you specify this parameter, only images whose similarity scores are greater than or equal to the threshold are returned. Valid values: 0.00 to 1.00. The value supports up to two decimal places. Default value: 0.00
parameters.help_zh: 填写相似度分数阈值后，只返回图片相似度分数大于等于阈值的图片信息。阈值范围0.00-1.00，最大支持2位小数，默认为0.00
parameters.name: score_threshold
